rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a Day 5 full blastocyst with visible compact ICM and generally adequate TE, and appropriately notes limits of judging TE from a single image. Minor omission of more explicit comment on somewhat non-expanded/collapsed appearance and zona features prevents a perfect score.

Strong integration of maternal age, PCOS, BMI, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, cycle context, and embryo morphology, with appropriate emphasis on age-related aneuploidy as the main prognostic modifier.

The reasoning is logical and internally consistent: good morphology and supportive transfer conditions improve prognosis, while age and untested status reduce it. Probability estimates are explained clearly and conclusions match the evidence presented.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and discussion of PGT-A at age 38. Slight uncertainty around fresh-transfer caveats and broad probability ranges keeps it from a top score.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, counseling, luteal support, and future-cycle planning, including metabolic review and PGT-A discussion. Useful and case-specific, though not highly detailed on protocol-level management.
